title: arboOCR Docs
description: arboOCR is a standalone C++ OCR library — text detection, orientation classification, and recognition over PP-OCRv6 ONNX models via ONNXRuntime, running on CPU, CUDA, or TensorRT. Wrappers for Python, Go, Rust, and PHP.

items.title: The accuracy cycle: the recognizer was never the problem
items.content_html: Cold arbo small went from ~84% to ~94% char similarity on the SROIE receipt smoke set — and none of it came from a bigger recognizer.
